mapper.update: UPDATE ai_registry_lock SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_service WHERE kind=#{kind} ORDER BY name,id
SELECT secret_encrypted,credential_purpose FROM ai_service WHERE secret_encrypted IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_service SET name=#{v.name},provider=#{v.provider},protocol=#{v.protocol},endpoint=#{v.endpoint},model=#{v.model},output_mode=#{v.outputMode},secret_encrypted=#{secret},credential_purpose=#{purpose},enabled=#{v.enabled},timeout_seconds=#{v.timeoutSeconds},max_results=#{v.maxResults},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{v.revision}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_feature WHERE model_service_id=#{id} OR search_service_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM ai_feature ORDER BY CASE id WHEN 'classification' THEN 0 WHEN 'default-search' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_feature SET model_service_id=#{v.modelServiceId},search_service_id=#{v.searchServiceId},enabled=#{v.enabled},interval_seconds=#{v.intervalSeconds},display_mode=#{v.displayMode},pet_id=#{v.petId},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{v.id} AND revision=#{v.revision}
